[RULES]
G1 Extract every piece of personal information of the supplied types. Return exact spans from the text.

[TYPE] NAME
[DESCRIPTION] A person's first, last or full name.

[TYPE] EMAIL
[DESCRIPTION] An email address.

[TYPE] PHONE
[DESCRIPTION] A phone or fax number.

[TYPE] STREET_ADDRESS
[DESCRIPTION] A house number and street name.

[TYPE] CITY
[DESCRIPTION] A city or town.

[TYPE] POSTCODE
[DESCRIPTION] A postcode or ZIP code.

[TYPE] DATE_OF_BIRTH
[DESCRIPTION] A person's date of birth.

[TYPE] ACCOUNT_NUMBER
[DESCRIPTION] A bank account, card or customer account number.

[TYPE] NOT_AN_ENTITY
NE1 Our own support contacts, such as "help@acme.com" or "+1 800 555 0100".

[RULES]
G2 If a number could be a phone number or an account number, the word before it decides: "call" or "phone" means PHONE, "account" or "no." means ACCOUNT_NUMBER. This overrides everything above.
